_comment: One entry per source. cadence is how often the scheduled workflow pulls it; the cron lives in .github/workflows/refresh-<name>.yml and tests/test_sources_config.py keeps the two in step. status: active = pulled on schedule; frozen = no longer pulled, last snapshot still read by the build.

colorado_proud.what: Colorado Proud Farm Fresh Directory (ArcGIS feature service), farmers markets only

usda_api.what: USDA Local Food Portal keyed API, five directories for Colorado

usda_datashare.what: USDA Local Food Portal data-share feed (opt-in listings, no key), gap filler

cfma.what: Colorado Farmers Market Association member markets (MarketWurks API)
cfma.note: Undocumented endpoint with no stated terms. Monthly on purpose; ask CFMA before increasing.

colorado_proud_finder.what: Colorado Proud member directory: 6 listing pages plus profiles not seen before
colorado_proud_finder.note: 1.5 s between requests. Profile cache is restored between runs; a cold cache is a ~40 minute crawl.

chaffee_provides.what: Chaffee Provides directory. Retired as a source on 2026-10-14: the Chaffee prototype site now reads from the Food Web, so pulling from it would be circular. Its last snapshot stays and is still built in; corrections go in inputs/overrides.csv.
